description: This file defines a PHP trait named UserRoleManagerTrait within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides methods to access user role management services and helpers via a dependency injection container, facilitating role management functionalities in classes that use this trait.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Returns an instance of AbstractUserRoleManager or BasicUserRoleManager by fetching the USER_ROLE_MANAGER service from the container.

methods.name: getUserRoleManagerHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of UserRoleManagerHelper by fetching the USER_ROLE_MANAGER_HELPER service from the container.
